library(tidyverse)

header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_A <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/qb25-answers/week1/hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header)
df_B <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/qb25-answers/week1/hg16-kc-count.bed", col_names=header)
x <-bind_rows( hg19=df_A, hg16=df_B, .id="assembly" ) 
ggplot(x, aes(x= start, y =count, color = assembly)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(chr ~., scales="free") +
  labs( title= "hg19 vs hg16",
    x = "start",
    y= "count"
  )
